title: Synergy Labs Blog | All About Lovable Pricing

facts.fact: Lovable's Free plan, as listed by Synergy Labs, provides 5 messages per day (30 per month).
facts.quote: Free Plan**: 5 messages/day (30 per month) - perfect for testing

facts.fact: Lovable's Pro plan, as listed by Synergy Labs, costs $25/month for 250 messages.
facts.quote: Pro Plan**: $25/month for 250 messages - ideal for solo builders

facts.fact: Lovable's Teams plan, as listed by Synergy Labs, costs $30/month and includes 20 seats.
facts.quote: Teams Plan**: $30/month for 20 seats - built for collaboration

facts.fact: Lovable's Enterprise plan is listed with custom pricing that includes SSO and dedicated support.
facts.quote: Enterprise**: Custom pricing with SSO and dedicated support

facts.fact: Synergy Labs states that Lovable uses message-based pricing rather than token-based pricing like competitors.
facts.quote: Message-based pricing (not token-based like competitors)

facts.fact: Synergy Labs reports that Lovable.dev reached £13.50 million ARR three months after launch (a claim the blog presents without citing a source).
facts.quote: Lovable.dev has hit £13.50 million ARR just three months after launch

facts.fact: Synergy Labs states that Lovable has more than 500,000 founders building apps.
facts.quote: with 500,000+ founders building apps _20 times faster_ than traditional coding

facts.fact: Synergy Labs cites a Lovable app-building speed claim of 20 times faster than traditional coding.
facts.quote: 500,000+ founders building apps _20 times faster_ than traditional coding

facts.fact: Synergy Labs cites a Lovable rating of 4.7 stars.
facts.quote: That 4.7-star rating didn't happen by accident.

facts.fact: The pricing comparison table lists the Free plan at $0 with public projects and the Lovable badge.
facts.quote: Free$05/day (30/month)Public projects, Lovable badge

facts.fact: Synergy Labs states that the Free plan's apps display the Lovable badge, which the Pro plan removes.
facts.quote: The **Pro plan at $25/month** removes that badge and opens up private projects

facts.fact: Synergy Labs states that the Pro plan's 250 monthly messages equal roughly 8 messages per day.
facts.quote: That's roughly 8 messages per day, which translates to substantial development work.

facts.fact: Synergy Labs states that the Teams plan includes 20 seats and starts at $30/month.
facts.quote: Teams pricing starts at **$30/month** and immediately changes the game with **20 seats included**.

facts.fact: Synergy Labs cites one founder who built 30 different app prototypes in 30 days.
facts.quote: One founder we know built 30 different app prototypes in 30 days

facts.fact: The Enterprise plan includes SSO, dedicated support, and data opt-out, per Synergy Labs' comparison table.
facts.quote: EnterpriseCustomCustomSSO, dedicated support, data opt-out

facts.fact: Lovable's message-based pricing counts one message as one credit, regardless of prompt complexity.
facts.quote: **Credit simplicity** changes everything. One message equals one credit, period.

facts.fact: According to the article, Lovable has no traditional LLM overage charges; when a user reaches the message limit, they must wait or upgrade.
facts.quote: **LLM overages** don't exist in the traditional sense - you simply hit your message limit and have to wait or upgrade.

facts.fact: Lovable's free plan includes 30 monthly messages, according to the article.
facts.quote: You start with 30 monthly messages on the free plan, graduate to 250 on Pro, then scale all the way up to **5,000+ messages on enterprise plans**.

facts.fact: Lovable's enterprise plans offer 5,000 or more monthly messages, according to the article.
facts.quote: then scale all the way up to **5,000+ messages on enterprise plans**.

facts.fact: The Lovable Teams plan includes 20 seats, according to the article.
facts.quote: That usage gets spread across 20 seats in the Teams plan, making the per-person cost surprisingly reasonable.

facts.fact: The article suggests a solo builder may use about 5-10 Lovable messages per day during active phases; this is the author's estimate, not Lovable data.
facts.quote: you'll probably use **5-10 messages per day** during active phases.

facts.fact: The article estimates a team may use 50-100 Lovable messages daily across several projects; this is the author's estimate.
facts.quote: you might burn through **50-100 messages daily** across several projects.

facts.fact: The article claims a simple styling request on token-based competitor platforms may cost $3 in compute, and a complex feature can burn $75 of tokens in one conversation.
facts.quote: A simple styling request might cost $3 in compute, while a complex feature could burn through $75 worth of tokens in a single conversation.

facts.fact: According to the article, Lovable reached £13.50 million in ARR, a vendor-reported figure with no date given.
facts.quote: That impressive jump to £13.50 million ARR didn't happen overnight

facts.fact: According to the article, over 10,000 custom domains are connected to Lovable-built applications.
facts.quote: With over **10,000 custom domains** connected to Lovable-built applications

facts.fact: The article states seat expansion becomes necessary when a team grows beyond 20 active users.
facts.quote: **Seat expansion** becomes necessary when your team grows beyond 20 active users

facts.fact: Lovable's free plan gives users 5 daily messages, capped at 30 monthly.
facts.quote: The free plan gives you **5 daily messages** (capped at 30 monthly) to test the waters without spending a dime.

facts.fact: Lovable's free plan includes 100GB of hosting bandwidth and unlimited public projects.
facts.quote: You get unlimited public projects and 100GB of hosting bandwidth, which is honestly pretty generous for getting started.

facts.fact: Lovable's Pro plan costs $25 per month and includes 250 monthly messages.
facts.quote: When you upgrade to **Pro at $25/month**, those training wheels come off. The badge disappears, your projects become private, and you get **250 monthly messages**.

facts.fact: Lovable's Pro plan provides 250 monthly messages.
facts.quote: you get **250 monthly messages**. Plus you get access to **dev mode** for direct code editing and **custom domain** support.

facts.fact: Lovable's Teams plan includes seats for up to 20 users.
facts.quote: Teams changes the game entirely** by adding **multiplayer collaboration** and **20 seats** for your whole crew.

facts.fact: Free-plan projects on Lovable display the Lovable badge and are public by default, while Pro removes the badge and makes projects private.
facts.quote: everything you build on the free plan displays the **Lovable badge**, and your projects are public by default.

facts.fact: Lovable's Enterprise plan offers custom message allowances based on actual usage patterns, rather than fixed tiers.
facts.quote: **custom message allowances** based on your actual usage patterns, **SSO integration** for security-conscious organizations, and **dedicated support** channels.

facts.fact: Lovable's Enterprise plan includes a data training opt-out option.
facts.quote: You also get **data training opt-out** to keep your proprietary code private.

facts.fact: The Synergy Labs blog claims Lovable can deliver a 20x development speed improvement for the right type of application.
facts.quote: That **20x development speed improvement** isn't marketing hyperbole when you're building the right type of application.

facts.fact: Lovable has a 4.7-star user rating, according to the blog.
facts.quote: The **4.7-star rating** from actual users backs up these speed claims.
